Leverage is moderate (total liabilities ~51.7% of assets; liabilities-to-equity ~1.07), but liquidity is weak with a current ratio below 1 (~0.79), indicating reliance on ongoing cash flow. Overall this suggests an intermediate credit profile leaning to investment-grade but not top-tier quality.
